items.question: How many days of fully paid maternity leave does a female employee appointed to a permanent position receive under the UAE Federal Government maternity leave rules?
items.gold: 90 days of fully paid maternity leave.
items.fact: Federal Government maternity leave is 90 days fully paid

items.question: How many paid working days of parental leave is an employee entitled to after a live-born child under the UAE Federal Government parental leave rules?
items.gold: 5 working days of paid parental leave.
items.fact: Federal Government parental leave is 5 paid working days
